messages:
emily (support): FYI customer 'PaperTrail' just opened an escalation — repeated 504s during streaming completions starting ~01:10 UTC. They say it affects ~10% of requests and they see partial chunks then a gap, then 504. Asked for timeline.

sre_oncall: Acknowledged, I'm in. Any correlation with deploys/rollouts around that time? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

emily (support): No deploys flagged in deploy-bot logs. They sent a sample curl that reproduces occasionally. Pasting below.

emily (support): ```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha","prompt":"stream test","max_tokens":200}' \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream
``` 

alice (eng-runtime): Thanks, digging into streaming proxy logs. I'm seeing lots of backend connections reset with TCP RST from our NLB around that window. Pattern: partial data forwarded then connection closed. Also some increases in active connections at that time.

bob (eng-infra): Confirming NLB metrics show a spike in new connections and concurrent connections on the edge layer. Idle connection count climbs then we see connection resets. NLB idle timeout currently 350s (default). Could be interaction with client keepalive or SDK behavior on streaming clients.

carla (solutions): Customer says their SDK retries on top-level requests after 60s, but streaming is single connection. They saw the client reconnect and resume but lost some tokens. Customer needs guidance and mitigation; they're high priority.

sre_oncall: Can we reproduce from our side? emily, can you run the curl repeatedly in a loop from a remote host to try to trigger? We'll tail the edge logs simultaneously.

emily (support): Running a short repro loop now from GCP us-west1. Will paste results.

emily (support): (after 3 mins) repro succeeded twice: sequence where first ~40 tokens arrive then connection drops with HTTP/1.1 504 from edge.

alice (eng-runtime): Pasting relevant proxy snippet from logs (sanitized):

alice (eng-runtime): ```
[2026-03-17T01:12:07Z] incoming conn id=0x7f3a data=63 bytes forwarded
[2026-03-17T01:12:07Z] backend id=10.1.8.12:443 got 1 chunk
[2026-03-17T01:12:08Z] connection reset by peer (code=RST)
[2026-03-17T01:12:08Z] returning 504 to client after proxy error
```

bob (eng-infra): Noted. NLB sending RSTs when backend connection is idle longer than its perception or if health check/proxy state flips. Also found a small config change we pushed last week to reduce socket keepalive from 300s -> 120s on the runtime side to free FDs faster under burst. That could make backend close earlier than NLB expects.

alice (eng-runtime): Oops — that change was intended for internal pods with short-lived RPCs, but streaming workloads are sensitive. The runtime will close idle streams after 120s now; older clients that rely on longer keepalive may be surprised. We'll revert the keepalive tweak as an emergency mitigation.

sre_oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) rollback runtime keepalive change (alice) 2) increase NLB idle timeout to 900s temporarily (bob) 3) ask customer to enable automatic client reconnects (carla) — do we have enough to stop impact?

bob (eng-infra): I can bump NLB idle timeout to 900s in us-west region in ~2m and monitor. Will also watch connection reset rate.

carla (solutions): I messaged the customer with suggested client settings and asked them to test. They acknowledged and will try during the window.

infra-bot: deploy-rollback succeeded: reverted commit 4f3d2b (runtime: socket keepalive -> 120s). Canary rollback to 3 pods in us-west complete.

alice (eng-runtime): Revert live. Rolling restart of streaming runtime pods initiated. Patch to revert is queued for formal PR; I'll follow up.

bob (eng-infra): NLB idle timeout increased to 900s (applied). Watching metrics now — connection resets dropped to baseline in the last 4 minutes.

sre_oncall: emily/carla — can you confirm with PaperTrail if they still see failures? If mitigated, we escalate to postmortem and action items.

emily (support): Customer tested; reported 10 mins after mitigations they no longer see 504s. They said client reconnect behavior helped, but primary fix was backend rollback + NLB change. They are satisfied for now.

carla (solutions): Great. Let's capture action items and postmortem owner. Drafting follow-up notes:

carla (solutions): Action items:
- A1: Formal postmortem (owner: alice) — include RCA and timeline. Due EOD +2 days.
- A2: Runbook update for streaming endpoints (owner: sre_oncall) — add steps for NLB idle timeout and runtime keepalive interplay. Due EOD +3 days.
- A3: Add monitoring alert for sudden rise in edge TCP_RSTs and partial-chunk 504s (owner: bob) — include dashboard and pager thresholds. Due EOD +4 days.
- A4: Add e2e test in CI that simulates long-lived streaming connections with different keepalive settings (owner: alice/carol?) — due +2 weeks.
- A5: Customer communication template for streaming partial-chunk loss and recommended client settings (owner: emily) — due +3 days.

alice (eng-runtime): I'll own the postmortem. Preliminary RCA: unintended keepalive reduction introduced on Mar 15th to reduce FD pressure; insufficient tagging/segmentation for streaming pods. That caused backend to close streams earlier; NLB then RST'd resulting in 504 to clients. Also gap: no synthetic test simulating long-lived streams.

bob (eng-infra): I'll add the TCP_RST alert and make the NLB idle timeout change permanent after consulting on cost/connection count tradeoffs. Also will add a pre-deploy test to ensure keepalive config not applied to streaming pool.

sre_oncall: I'll update the runbook with exact mitigation commands and the query to identify the pattern (logs + metrics). Patch will be in our ops repo.

emily (support): I'll send the customer a summary and ask if they'd like a postmortem ETA. They asked for a short explanation so I'll include the high-level RCA and the upcoming fixes.

carla (solutions): One more item: review SDKs/docs to highlight streaming resilience patterns (reconnect, idempotency markers). Owner: carla + docs. Due +2 weeks.

sre_oncall: Closing loop for this channel. We'll collate the notes and open a postmortem doc. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

emily (support): Thanks team — will mark escalation resolved and cc customer when postmortem is ready.

alice (eng-runtime): Filing PR for revert + test to prevent regression. Will ping when merged.

bob (eng-infra): Leaving monitoring watch on for next 24h.

infra-bot: alert cleared: edge-tcp-rst-rate (us-west) at 2026-03-17T01:20:12Z
